items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: We were playing in Cleveland in vaudeville... And who's on the bill but Bo Jangles Robinson... So after our first show Bill Robinson says, hey kid, come here. I'm going to put you into something he says... And he showed me the steps

ctx.x: Did he ever work with you after that?

Oh yes. Now comes the time where we work together. Because what happened was, Dick Voynow, we did a little vaudeville around the area there with the band. That's when I started singing and we went in vaudeville.

Here's a little interesting thing, anecdote that might be interesting. We were playing in Cleveland in vaudeville, I've forgotten the name of the theater. And who's on the bill but Bo Jangles Robinson. (Bo Jangles?).
MRS. JOHNSTON: The dancer?
MR. MCPARTLAND: Yes.
MRS. JOHNSTON: The tap dancer.
MR. MCPARTLAND: It's terrible I can't even think of his first name. Robinson, that's frightening, that I can't think of it because what happened was, I was singing ....
MRS. JOHNSTON: Bill?
MR. MCPARTLAND: Bill Robinson,…
